name: comp-256
title: Emoji Rating Slider
description: A five-step satisfaction slider with a cross face at one end and a heart-eyes face at the other. The current step is spelled out in a word beside the prompt.
use: A survey or checkout wants a fast five-point satisfaction score that feels light.
avoid: The result is only a feeling out of five; there is no room for a written reason.
a11y: The slider has a name, but the emoji are bare text and the rating word is not announced when the value changes. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: The prompt Rate your experience sits on the left with a single rating word on the right. Underneath, a red angry emoji and a grinning heart-eyes emoji bracket a white-filled slider track with a round knob.
behaves: Dragging the knob along the track snaps through five positions and swaps the trailing word between Awful, Poor, Okay, Good and Amazing. The white fill grows behind the knob as it moves right.
customise: The prompt, the five rating words and the two emoji are written in the source; the number of steps and their wording need edits.
weight: light: One slider, two emoji and a word; nothing animates until dragged.
